Why Rome03
Easy to reach, easy to stay

From the plane
to the first tee.

The venue lies in the south-west of Rome (EUR / Magliana area), between the city centre and Fiumicino Airport. The hotel is inside the golf complex and runs a shuttle to Fiumicino: players fly in, check in and walk to the course.

Fiumicino (FCO)
~12 km

15–20 minutes by car. Hotel shuttle service to the airport.

Ciampino (CIA)
~20 km

About 30 minutes by car.

Rome Termini
25–30 min

Central station, well served by public transport.

Hotel to course
0 min

Sheraton Rome Parco de' Medici is inside the golf complex.

The venue04
Golf Club Parco de' Medici

Three golf courses
and a hotel inside the venue.

A 27-hole golf complex in Rome, with the White, Blue and Red nines, and the Sheraton Rome Parco de' Medici hotel inside the venue. One site for playing, staying, eating and celebrating.

Golf

27 holes, three courses

Room for the 18-hole FootGolf competition layout and a separate practice layout.

Hotel

Sheraton on site

Upscale accommodation within walking distance of the course, with airport shuttle.

Clubhouse

Everything in one place

Restaurant and bar, changing rooms, toilets, large car park, power and Wi-Fi.

Format and schedule07
Practice day plus two rounds

Three days,
one round per day.

2Friday · July

Official practice

  • Practice on the competition layout
  • Registration and accreditation
  • Welcome ceremony
3Saturday · July

Round 1

  • Two-tee or shotgun start, two waves
  • Lunch included
  • BlueGolf live scoring
4Sunday · July

Round 2 · Final

  • Same number of rounds for every category
  • Lunch included
  • Prize giving and closing ceremony

About 15 hours of daylight in early July (sunrise ~05:40, sunset ~20:45): early tee times keep play out of the hottest hours.

Operations and safety09
People and plans in place

Run safely,
fairly and on time.

Team

Tournament staff

Tournament Director, Rules Director, English-speaking operational lead, Media Lead.

On course

Marshals and volunteers

Non-playing staff and marshals, trained starters and score reviewers.

Medical

First aid on site

First-aid team and ambulance; Ospedale Sant'Eugenio about 5 km away. Event insurance.

Weather

Heat and storm plan

Early tee times, water and shade, lightning protocol, clubhouse as shelter.

Written risk assessment and emergency action plan. The FIFG representative is hosted in a single room, with meals, on the same basis as the player package.

Content for FIFG channels

Rome,
seen around the world.

Guaranteed

Every day

Live broadcast

Our commitments11
An FIFG 500 to FIFG standards

What Italy commits to.

  • FIFG Rules of the Game, World Tour and Competition Guidelines, approved local rules
  • Anti-doping requirements and a private control room if testing is scheduled
  • BlueGolf for setup, live scoring, verification and results
  • Entry-only option and every charge disclosed in EUR
  • FIFG and partner branding on course, live scoring and digital content
  • Calendar coordination and Open-date clash rules acknowledged
  • Integrity, safeguarding and anti-corruption requirements
  • Registration opening communicated to all 2026 participants
